newsitem.title: CHINA: China's first life insurance jv to start soon.
newsitem.headline: China's first life insurance jv to start soon.

text.p: China's first life insurance joint venture expects to start operations in Shanghai later this year, company officials said on Wednesday.

Zhong Hong Life Insurance Company was formed on May 2, 1996, with partners Manulife (International) Ltd, a Hong Kong-based unit of Manulife Financial, and China Trust and Investment Corporation for Foreign Economic Relations and Trade, a member of the Sinochem Group.
The company is waiting for a final licence from the People's Bank of China, a company official said.

Zhong Hong will offer life insurance, medical, pension, investment and savings-related products to people in the Shanghai area and plans to have 2,000 professional agents and staff within four years, a company statement said.
The company, registered in the Pudong New Area, has an initial registered capital of 200 million yuan, 51 percent held by the foreign partner and 49 percent by the Chinese partner.
Zhong Hong hopes to extend operations from Shanghai to other cities in China after receiving approval from the central bank, company officials told reporters.
Manulife Financial has five Chinese representative offices, in Beijing, Shenzhen, Shanghai, Chengdu and Guangzhou.
